title: SHATTER: a real image breaking like glass
license: Technique reference only: rebuild it in code; never paste the site's output.
use: On the drop or the big reveal, fracture a REAL capture: a seeded Voronoi diagram (d3-delaunay, ~40-120 cells, denser near an impact point) clips the image into shards; each shard gets a deterministic velocity, spin and slight 3D tilt from the impact, a thin bright edge (refraction highlight), and falls/expands over 10-24 frames to reveal the next scene beneath. Add an "impact" or "boom" sfx event on the break frame.
